title: Average Annual Increase in Mexican Silver Libertad Value
takeaway: The Mexican Silver Libertad has experienced an average annual increase of 6-8% over the past decade.

data.label: Average Annual Increase
data.evidence: According to recent market analysis, the Mexican Silver Libertad has seen an average annual increase of approximately 6-8% over the past decade.
